one_liner: Podio has a free-to-use REST API with self-serve OAuth2 app registration, broad coverage, and an official hosted MCP server at mcp.podio.com.
auth_notes: Server-side authorization-code flow is the recommended method; app authentication (app token) is available for scripts. Developers grab an API key (client ID/secret) from account settings. Some destructive operations need an increased trust level via support.
access_notes: Free and paid accounts have full API access at the same base rate limits (1000 calls/hour); add-ons for higher limits are paid-only and optional. Max 5 API keys per user.
blocker_notes: No blocker found. The free plan includes API access, and API key registration is self-serve.

evidence.quote: The recommended authentication method for the Podio API is the [OAuth server-side flow](https://developers.podio.com/authentication/server_side).
The Podio API is available to use for both paid and free Podio accounts. Both have full access to the API and the same base rate Limit A and Limit B apply.
You have to [sign in or sign up](https://podio.com/home?force_locale=en_US) with Podio.
